Introduction
This document lists the Minor Maintenance Procedures P1, which
 must be performed every year as indicated by Y1 in the title block.or after
 every heavy short circuit.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The Isolator must be Isolated from two sides.
Local grounding must be at the two side of the IS. SW.
Use only fiberglass ladder.
